headline: "Masud Rana" creator Qazi Anwar Hussain dies

members.title: Writer Qazi Anwar Hussain laid to rest
"Masud Rana" creator Qazi Anwar Hussain dies
members.lead: Qazi Anwar Hussain, the popular writer of the detective series, Masud Rana, died on Wednesday afternoon. He was 86. He was undergoing treatment at the city’s BIRDEM hospital after suffering a heart attack and a stroke. He also suffered from prostate cancer. Besides “Masud Rana”, Qazi Anwar Hussain penned many other thrillers and adventure stories. Through his popular fictional works and publications company, Sheba Prokashoni, he created a generation of readers in Bangladesh. He was son of the late National Professor Qazi Motahar Hussain and obtained his graduate and postgraduate degrees in Bangla from Dhaka University. MH Editor : M.
